harness.message: Do not mark H-WP-02 complete and do not select either current ledger lineage unchanged. Execute the new exact differential probe, then merge content identity, version identity and trace identity as distinct surfaces. Preserve A verification/recovery and B typed/domain-epoch semantics.

frank.message: H1 must preserve the live frankv0.1 transaction/epoch root as a compatibility identity or record an intentional tested divergence. Additive semantic-content and trace hashes are preferable to silently redefining the existing root.

claycode.message: ClayCode/H2 needs explicit typed collection canonicalization and distinct semantic-content, state-version and execution-trace identities. One overloaded semantic_state_hash is insufficient.

unifieddb.message: Persist semantic content identity separately from epoch/history version identity and execution/provenance trace identity. Domain epochs/read-set conflict guards should not be conflated with content equality.

claygraph.message: Dynamic Run ClayGraph edges should bind pre/post semantic-content hash, state-version hash and trace root separately so graph replay can distinguish same-content/different-history from true semantic divergence.
